mission: Test Value Auditor V5: Empirical Data-Driven Scoring

tasks.title: Parse pytest execution reports for actual runtimes
tasks.description: Create parser for pytest --junitxml and pytest-reportlog outputs to extract actual test execution times (not keyword-based heuristics). Support multiple formats (JUnit XML, pytest-json-report). FALLBACK: If no junitxml available, use heuristics mode (keyword-based estimation). IDEMPOTENCY: Safe to re-run without corrupting data (read-only parser).
acceptance_criteria: Parses JUnit XML files successfully
Parses pytest-reportlog JSON files
Extracts duration_seconds per test with precision to milliseconds
Handles missing/incomplete reports gracefully with heuristics fallback
Returns dict[test_id, runtime_seconds] mapping
Idempotent: Re-running produces identical results

tasks.title: Implement non-linear runtime penalty function
tasks.description: Replace linear runtime penalty (-runtime * 0.1) with non-linear function that steeply penalizes tests >30s (exponential/threshold-based). Formula: penalty = runtime_sec * (1 + exp((runtime_sec - 30) / 10)) for runtime >30s.
acceptance_criteria: Tests <10s have minimal penalty (<1 point)
Tests 10-30s have moderate penalty (1-3 points)
Tests >30s have steep penalty (5-20 points)
Tests >60s have extreme penalty (20+ points)
Formula is configurable via weights.yaml

tasks.title: Test runtime data parser with actual pytest output
tasks.description: Validate runtime parser against real pytest output files. Test edge cases: missing durations, malformed XML, empty reports. Verify non-linear penalty function correctness.
acceptance_criteria: Parses sample JUnit XML with 100+ tests
Handles empty/missing duration fields
Non-linear penalty matches expected values for 10s/30s/60s tests
Integration test with real test_value_audit.py output

tasks.title: Provision CI access tokens and artifact permissions
tasks.description: Configure CI access: GitHub Actions artifact download permission, workflow log read access. Generate GITHUB_TOKEN with repo:read + actions:read scopes. Document token provisioning in CI/CD setup guide.
acceptance_criteria: GITHUB_TOKEN with actions:read scope provisioned
GitHub Actions artifact download permission verified
Access to workflow logs (last 90 days) confirmed
Token stored securely (environment variable, not committed)
Fallback documented: manual log download if API unavailable

tasks.title: Parse CI logs for test failure history
tasks.description: Extract test failure events from CI logs (last 30-90 days). Support GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Jenkins formats. Track: test_id, failure_date, failure_reason, fixed_date. Store in SQLite database (.audit/failure_history.sqlite) for fast queries. FALLBACK: If CI access fails, use local pytest cache. IDEMPOTENCY: Upsert-based (safe re-run).
acceptance_criteria: Parses GitHub Actions workflow logs
Extracts pytest failure output (test name, traceback)
Calculates failure frequency (failures per 90 days)
Distinguishes flaky tests (fails 2-9/10 runs) vs consistent failures (10/10) vs fixed bugs (1-2 failures, then 0)
Stores in SQLite at .audit/failure_history.sqlite with indexes for <100ms queries
Performance SLA: Queries <100ms for 5k tests, DB size <50MB for 90 days history
Idempotent: Re-running updates existing records (upsert logic)

tasks.title: Add failure history bonus to scoring formula
tasks.description: Integrate failure history into test value scoring. Formula: + (recent_failures * FAILURE_BONUS_WEIGHT). FAILURE_BONUS_WEIGHT=5 (configurable). Recent failures = failures in last 90 days that were subsequently fixed (proven bug detectors). FLAKY DEFINITION: Fails 2-9/10 runs. FIXED DEFINITION: 0 failures in last 3 consecutive CI runs after previous failures.
acceptance_criteria: Tests with 0 failures get 0 bonus
Tests with 1-2 recent failures (then fixed per definition) get +5-10 bonus (proven bug detectors)
Tests with 3+ failures (then fixed) get +15 bonus (critical regression tests)
Flaky tests (2-9/10 fails, never reach 3 consecutive passes) get -5 penalty (unreliable)
Consistent failures (10/10 fails) get 0 bonus (not fixed, likely test bug)
Bonus weight is configurable in weights.yaml
Fixed definition: Pass in 3 consecutive CI runs after last failure

tasks.title: Test failure history integration with scoring
tasks.description: Validate failure history bonus calculation. Test edge cases: no failures, flaky tests, fixed regressions. Verify SQLite query performance (<100ms for 5k tests).
acceptance_criteria: Test with 2 fixed failures scores +10 bonus
Flaky test (12 failures, never fixed) scores -5 penalty
No-failure test scores 0 bonus
SQLite query performance <100ms for 5,408 tests
Integration test with test_value_audit.py

phases.title: Git Churn and Last Modified Analysis

tasks.title: Analyze git history for test churn
tasks.description: Use git log to track test file modifications. Calculate co-change frequency (test modified alongside production code). Track: commits_last_90_days, lines_changed, co-change_count. High co-change = brittle test (breaks on refactor).
acceptance_criteria: Runs git log --numstat --follow on test files
Calculates commits per test file (last 90 days)
Detects co-changes (test + production file in same commit)
Calculates last_modified date for age penalty
Performance: <5s for 5,000 test files

tasks.title: Enhance maintenance burden with churn + age factors
tasks.description: Update _score_maintenance_burden() to include: (1) git churn (co-change frequency), (2) test age (years since last modified). Formula: burden += (co_change_count * 1.5) + (years_since_modified * AGE_PENALTY_WEIGHT). AGE_PENALTY_WEIGHT=0.5 (old tests may be obsolete).
acceptance_criteria: Tests with high co-change (5+ commits) get +7.5 burden penalty
Tests >2 years old get +1.0 age penalty (may be obsolete)
Tests <6 months old get 0 age penalty
Churn and age weights configurable in weights.yaml
Backward compatible (works without git data)

tasks.title: Test git churn and age penalty calculations
tasks.description: Validate git churn analysis and age penalty. Test edge cases: new tests (0 commits), deleted tests, renamed files. Verify performance on large repos (1000+ test files).
acceptance_criteria: Test modified 5 times with production code gets +7.5 churn penalty
Test last modified 3 years ago gets +1.5 age penalty
New test (0 commits) gets 0 churn penalty
Git log parsing completes <5s for Agency repo (5k tests)
Integration test with test_value_audit.py

tasks.title: Classify mocks as external vs internal
tasks.description: Analyze mock targets to distinguish: (1) external mocks (DB, API, filesystem) - acceptable, (2) internal mocks (project classes) - code smell. Use AST to parse mock targets. External patterns: 'requests', 'psycopg2', 'Path', 'open'. Internal: project module names.
acceptance_criteria: Detects external mocks: MagicMock(spec=requests.Session)
Detects internal mocks: MagicMock(spec=AgentContext)
Calculates external_mock_count and internal_mock_count separately
Returns mock classification per test
Performance: <10ms per test function

tasks.title: Refine maintenance burden based on mock context
tasks.description: Update maintenance burden formula: external_mocks get 0.3x penalty (acceptable), internal_mocks get 0.8x penalty (tests implementation). Formula: burden += (external_mocks * 0.3) + (internal_mocks * 0.8). High internal mock count = implementation detail testing.
acceptance_criteria: Test with 5 external mocks (DB) gets +1.5 penalty (acceptable overhead)
Test with 5 internal mocks (classes) gets +4.0 penalty (code smell)
Mixed mocks calculated correctly (3 external + 2 internal = 0.9 + 1.6 = 2.5)
Mock weights configurable in weights.yaml
Backward compatible with existing mock_count metric

tasks.title: Test mock classification accuracy
tasks.description: Validate mock classifier against known test cases. Test edge cases: nested mocks, spec= vs spec_set=, patching. Verify maintenance burden calculation with different mock mixes.
acceptance_criteria: Correctly classifies MagicMock(spec=requests.Session) as external
Correctly classifies MagicMock(spec=AgentContext) as internal
Handles patch('agency.tools.bash.subprocess') correctly
Maintenance burden calculation verified for 10 test samples
Integration test with test_value_audit.py

tasks.title: Create weights.yaml configuration schema
tasks.description: Design weights.yaml schema for configurable scoring weights. Include: bug_detection_weight, critical_path_weight, integration_bonus, runtime_penalty_threshold, failure_bonus_weight, age_penalty_weight, mock_penalties (external/internal), normalization settings (z-score/min-max).
acceptance_criteria: Schema supports all 8 scoring components
Default values based on current empirical data
Normalization mode: 'none', 'z-score', 'min-max'
Validation rules for weight ranges (0-10)
Example weights.yaml with comments

tasks.title: Implement weights.yaml loader and validator
tasks.description: Load weights from weights.yaml, validate schema, apply defaults if missing. Use Pydantic for validation. Support environment variable overrides (AUDIT_WEIGHTS_FILE). Cache parsed weights for performance.
acceptance_criteria: Loads weights.yaml successfully
Validates weight ranges (0-10 for multipliers, 0-100 for thresholds)
Falls back to defaults if file missing
Supports AUDIT_WEIGHTS_FILE env variable
Caches parsed weights (no re-read on every test)

tasks.title: Implement z-score and min-max normalization
tasks.description: Add score normalization to make components comparable. Z-score: (value - mean) / stddev. Min-max: (value - min) / (max - min) * range. Apply per-component before weighted sum. Configurable via weights.yaml normalization_mode.
acceptance_criteria: Z-score normalization implemented correctly
Min-max normalization implemented correctly
None mode (no normalization) supported
Normalization applied per scoring component (bug_detection, critical_path, etc.)
Edge cases handled: all values same (stddev=0), single value

tasks.title: Test configurable weights and normalization
tasks.description: Validate weights.yaml loading, schema validation, normalization correctness. Test edge cases: missing file, invalid weights, normalization with outliers.
acceptance_criteria: Loads valid weights.yaml successfully
Rejects invalid weights (out of range)
Z-score normalization matches expected values (verified with numpy)
Min-max normalization produces [0,1] range
Handles missing weights.yaml gracefully (defaults)

phases.title: Grid Search Tuner for Weight Calibration

tasks.title: Create manual test labeling tool
tasks.description: Build CLI tool for manual test quality labeling. Display test code, current score, ask user: 'Keep/Review/Delete/Consolidate?'. Save labels to labeled_tests.json for calibration. Support batch labeling (50-100 tests).
acceptance_criteria: CLI displays test code with syntax highlighting
Shows current score components breakdown
Captures user label (Keep/Review/Delete/Consolidate)
Saves to labeled_tests.json with timestamp
Supports resume (skip already labeled tests)
Target: 50-100 labeled samples for calibration

tasks.title: Test manual labeling tool functionality
tasks.description: Validate manual labeling tool UX, JSON output format, resume functionality
acceptance_criteria: Manual labeling tool displays test code correctly
Saves valid labeled_tests.json
Resume functionality works (skips already labeled)
Handles edge cases: empty tests, malformed code

tasks.title: Implement grid search for weight optimization
tasks.description: Grid search to find optimal weights.yaml that maximizes agreement with manual labels. Search space: bug_detection_weight (5-15), critical_path_weight (3-7), etc. Metric: accuracy (predicted action matches manual label). Use sklearn GridSearchCV pattern.
acceptance_criteria: Grid search over 6+ weight dimensions
Evaluates accuracy against labeled_tests.json
Reports best weights with accuracy score
Generates optimized weights.yaml
Runtime <10 minutes for 50 samples, 100 grid points
Logs search progress (current accuracy, best so far)

tasks.title: Test weight calibration pipeline end-to-end
tasks.description: Validate manual labeling tool UX, grid search correctness, weight optimization. Test with synthetic labeled data (known optimal weights).
acceptance_criteria: Manual labeling tool saves valid JSON
Grid search finds optimal weights for synthetic data (accuracy >90%)
Optimized weights improve accuracy vs defaults
End-to-end pipeline runs <15 minutes
Generated weights.yaml is valid and loadable

phases.title: Manual Review Pipeline and Safety Mechanisms

tasks.title: Generate PR with deletion candidates (never auto-delete)
tasks.description: Create PR with candidates_to_delete.txt, run CI, require human approval. Include: (1) list of tests to delete, (2) backup of deleted tests (zip + timestamp), (3) revert script, (4) CI check for test suite health. NEVER delete tests automatically (constitutional safety). FLAGS: --dry-run (preview only, no PR), --apply (create PR). REVERT: Documented in revert.sh with 1-command restore.
acceptance_criteria: Generates candidates_to_delete.txt with LOW score tests (<10)
Creates backup.{timestamp}.zip with test file copies
Generates revert.sh script to restore deleted tests (1-command: ./revert.sh backup.{timestamp}.zip)
Creates GitHub PR with detailed description
PR requires approval + CI pass before merge
PR description includes: test count, score distribution, risk assessment
--dry-run flag: Preview candidates without creating PR
--apply flag: Required to actually create PR (safety)
Revert behavior documented: unzip backup, git checkout, restore all tests

tasks.title: Create visual audit report (histogram + sampling)
tasks.description: Generate visual report with: (1) score histogram (matplotlib), (2) top 10 highest-value tests, (3) bottom 10 lowest-value tests, (4) stratified sample of LOW tests for manual review (sample_size configurable, default 50). Stratified sampling: include tests at bucket edges (scores 9, 10, 11) for calibration validation. Output: HTML report with interactive charts.
acceptance_criteria: Histogram shows score distribution (bins: 0-10, 10-20, 20-30, 30+)
Top 10 and bottom 10 tests listed with code snippets
Stratified sample of LOW tests (default sample_size=50, configurable)
Stratified sampling includes bucket-edge tests (e.g., score 9, 10, 11) for calibration
HTML report with embedded charts (no external dependencies)
Report includes: test count, avg score, median, std dev
Sample size configurable via --sample-size flag

tasks.title: Test PR generation and visual reporting
tasks.description: Validate PR generator creates valid GitHub PR, backup/revert scripts work, visual report renders correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Generated candidates_to_delete.txt is valid
Backup directory contains all test files
Revert script successfully restores deleted tests
HTML report renders in browser
Histogram shows expected distribution for sample data

tasks.title: Collect baseline metrics before cleanup
tasks.description: Measure baseline metrics: (1) CI runtime (pytest --durations=0), (2) flaky test rate (run 10x, count failures), (3) test suite size (count, LOC), (4) coverage percentage. Store in .audit/metrics_baseline.json for comparison. IDEMPOTENCY: Appends timestamped entries (safe re-run). Performance SLA: <30 minutes for 5k tests (10 runs).
acceptance_criteria: Runs pytest 10 times, measures avg runtime and std dev
Identifies flaky tests (failed 1-9 out of 10 runs per definition)
Calculates test suite size (count, total LOC)
Measures code coverage (pytest-cov)
Saves to .audit/metrics_baseline.json with timestamp
Performance SLA: Completes <30 minutes for full Agency suite
Idempotent: Re-running appends new baseline entry (history preserved)

tasks.title: Collect post-cleanup metrics and generate comparison report
tasks.description: Re-run metrics collection after test cleanup. Generate comparison report: CI runtime improvement, flaky test reduction, coverage delta, bug escape rate (manual input). Validate KPIs improved (A/B style validation).
acceptance_criteria: Collects same metrics as baseline (runtime, flaky rate, coverage)
Calculates deltas: runtime reduction %, flaky test reduction count
Generates comparison report (Markdown + JSON)
Validates: CI runtime reduced by ≥30%, flaky tests reduced by ≥50%
Includes manual input for bug escape rate (bugs found in prod post-cleanup)

tasks.title: Test metrics collection accuracy
tasks.description: Validate baseline metrics collector, post-cleanup comparison, report generation. Test with synthetic data (known improvements).
acceptance_criteria: Baseline collector runs successfully on Agency test suite
Flaky test detection works (identify known flaky tests)
Comparison report shows correct deltas
Validation passes for expected improvements (synthetic data)
Report generation completes <5 minutes

phases.title: Integration with Existing Test Value Auditor

tasks.title: Refactor test_value_audit.py to use new scoring engine
tasks.description: Replace heuristic-based scoring in test_value_audit.py with empirical data-driven scoring. Integrate: runtime parser, failure history, git churn, mock classifier, configurable weights, normalization. Maintain backward compatibility (fallback to heuristics if data unavailable).
acceptance_criteria: Uses actual runtime data if available (fallback to heuristics)
Integrates failure history bonus if CI logs parsed
Includes git churn and age penalties
Distinguishes external vs internal mocks
Applies z-score normalization if configured
Backward compatible: works without any empirical data (defaults to heuristics)

tasks.title: End-to-end test of enhanced audit system
tasks.description: Run complete audit on Agency test suite (5,408 tests) with all enhancements enabled. Verify: runtime data integration, failure history, git churn, mock classification, normalization, configurable weights. Compare results to baseline (V4 audit). CONFIGURABLE: execution_time_limit (default 6h, prevents CI killer), max_workers (default 4, prevents memory exhaustion).
acceptance_criteria: Audit completes successfully on full 5,408 test suite
Runtime data integrated for all tests
Failure history bonus applied correctly
Git churn penalties reflect actual repo history
Mock classification improves maintenance burden accuracy

Generated report includes all new metrics

Max workers configurable (default 4, prevents repo CI/runner kill)
Memory usage <6GB during full audit run

tasks.title: Create ADR-034: Empirical Test Value Scoring
tasks.description: Document architectural decision to replace heuristic scoring with empirical data-driven approach. acceptance_criteria: ADR follows existing format (docs/adr/ADR-INDEX.md)
Context explains V4 limitations (74% P1, 60% false gaps)
Decision details 8 enhancements (runtime, failure history, git churn, etc.)
Consequences include: calibration improvement, false positive reduction

acceptance_criteria: HANDOFF updated with V5 instructions
weights.yaml configuration documented with examples
Grid search tuner usage documented (labeling + optimization)
